name: mail-mcp
description: Read, search, file, delete and unsubscribe from newsletters in a personal Outlook.com / Hotmail mailbox.
long_description: Mail-MCP lets Claude triage a personal Outlook.com or Hotmail mailbox through Microsoft Graph: list folders, search and read messages, summarise senders, move or delete messages, and unsubscribe from mailing lists. Claude signs you in from the chat. Mail-MCP talks only to Microsoft, plus the sender's own unsubscribe address when you ask to unsubscribe.

tools.name: mail_list_folders
tools.description: List every folder of the mailbox with its path, message count and unread count.

tools.name: mail_create_folder
tools.description: Create a mail folder at the root or under a parent folder (idempotent).

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: List or search messages of a folder, newest first, with sender, date and unread filters.

tools.name: mail_get_message
tools.description: Read one message in full, with the unsubscribe options found in its headers.

tools.name: mail_senders_summary
tools.description: Scan a folder and aggregate messages by sender, with the available unsubscribe method.

tools.name: mail_move
tools.description: Move one or more messages to a folder.

tools.name: mail_delete
tools.description: Delete one or more messages (to Deleted Items by default).

tools.name: mail_bulk_by_sender
tools.description: Move or delete every message from one sender in a folder, with a dry-run option.

tools.name: mail_unsubscribe
tools.description: Unsubscribe from the mailing list of a message: one-click, a link to open, or an email link you send yourself.

tools.name: mail_login
tools.description: Sign in to the Outlook.com mailbox through the browser.

tools.name: mail_logout
tools.description: Sign out and remove the sign-in stored on this computer.

client_id.title: Your own Entra client ID (advanced)
client_id.description: Leave empty to use the built-in Mail-MCP app.
